text: 2026-09-29 local execution/io: Retained estimate HDF5 remains open. Verified jhdf 0.12.0 binary API: WritableGroup.putDataset(String,Object) only; WritableDataset exposes no incremental slice/chunk write, while Dataset reads have getData(long[],int[]). Current JhdfLnaHdf5Store eagerly materializes LNA payloads and publishes with replacing move. Bounded estimate begin/write/seal with no-clobber needs a provider capability for typed chunk/slice writes plus close/flush, or another qualified generic HDF5 writer. Do not relabel LNA or development NIfTI as HDF5 conformance. Work continues on Core-NIfTI schema/integrity.
